title: Zynask First
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - Comedy]
You ask me for the VDS IP like I’m supposed to read your mind
I been building zynmirror, zip-local, tailscale-install the whole time
You got the a07 on Tailscale, coreys-iphone too
But when I say “ssh corey@VDS” you act brand new

[Chorus - Group]
Hah! You don’t know the VDS IP!
You don’t know the VDS IP!
I gave you zyn-connect v8.1, dry-run and zip
You still asking for the IP like it’s 2016

[Bridge - Spoken]
Zynask first. VDS is boss.
Boundary Iron locked. 336.
Stop asking questions I already answered in the log
Just run the command, king, you already strong
